# Screener Specification

## Source Intent
Signal candle low is the lowest of the last 40 days, but the signal candle closes in green with at least a 2% gain from low. It's only for buy stock and no other direction should be included.

## Universe
NIFTY 200

## Timeframe
Daily candles

## Conditions
1. Signal candle low is the lowest of the last 40 days.
2. Signal candle closes in green with at least 2% gain from low.


## Direction
- BUY: Signal candle closes in green with at least 2% gain from the lowest low of the last 40 days.

## Filters
None

## Sort Order
Default sort: Last price (LTP) descending.

## Date Scope
- Mode: range
- Default days: 5

## Output Fields
- Symbol [stock]
- Direction [direction]
- Last price (LTP) [close]
- SuperTrend [superTrend]
- Avg volume (20) [vma20]

## Presentation
- Style: Ranked table
- Controls: Symbol search box, Click-to-sort column headers
- Show at most: 50 stocks
- Overflow: Numbered pages, 25 per page.

## Attached Chart Verification

Replay the confirmed conditions at each marked candle's OPEN timestamp in IST. Use the attached PNG as visual evidence, not as a substitute for real candle and indicator history.

| Chart / Mark | Symbol | Date/time (IST) | Interval | Expected output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| clmw3ycx5zl5 / mkmw3ybinzk7 | RELIANCE | 2025-04-09T00:00 | daily | Included at this candle |
| clmw3ycx5zl5 / mkmw3ybmcekf | RELIANCE | 2025-04-07T00:00 | daily | Included at this candle |

A successful verification requires every SIGNAL to appear and every AVOID to be absent at the specified symbol, timestamp and timeframe. No skipped/xfail tests or missing-data passes. Record the actual matched rows, evaluated condition values, test command and pass/fail output. Passing these samples verifies the attached examples, not profitability or all future signals.
